purpose: Research inventory for per-world treasure grids and acquisition-detail views. Documentation only; no runtime implementation or progress migration.

evidenceDefinitions.directlyCorroborated: An inspected game image identifies an exact selected reward/position. Only the observed pair/state is corroborated; capture platform/build may still be unknown.
evidenceDefinitions.sourceSupportedNativeOrder: A source explicitly describes journal order, with identity cross-check. Not hands-on target-edition gameplay verification.
evidenceDefinitions.sourceNumberCandidate: A number from a canonical extraction/source table. It must not be presented as an official journal slot without order evidence and a scoped identity join.
